CustomObject.description: Admin-defined regex masking rules for the SF PEG Data360 query tool. Active rules are applied server-side to result values before they leave the Apex controller, so PII (e.g. ID-card / IBAN numbers) never reaches the browser for standard users. Holders of the sfpegData360BypassMasking custom permission see raw, unmasked output.
CustomObject.label: Data360 Query Data Masking Rule
